scripts.prebuild: pnpm run build:fitness-kb-data && pnpm run build:6pack-data
scripts.build: vite build && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist --app vitalos && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs splash dist --app vitalos
scripts.prebuild:firebase: pnpm run build:fitness-kb-data && pnpm run build:6pack-data
scripts.build:firebase: node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs && vite build --mode firebase && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs --write-service-workers dist-firebase && node scripts/test-product-firebase-isolation.mjs dist-firebase && pnpm run stamp:sw
scripts.build:firebase:store: pnpm run build:fitness-kb-data && pnpm run build:6pack-data && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs && VITE_VOS_EDITION=store vite build --mode firebase --outDir dist-store && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs --write-service-workers dist-store && node scripts/test-product-firebase-isolation.mjs dist-store && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs stamp dist-store --app vitalos
scripts.build:firebase:observe: pnpm run build:fitness-kb-data && pnpm run build:6pack-data && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs && VITE_VOS_EDITION=observe vite build --mode firebase --outDir dist-observe && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs --write-service-workers dist-observe && node scripts/test-product-firebase-isolation.mjs dist-observe && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs stamp dist-observe --app observe
scripts.build:firebase:operate: pnpm run build:fitness-kb-data && pnpm run build:6pack-data && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs && VITE_VOS_EDITION=operate vite build --mode firebase --outDir dist-operate && node scripts/prepare-vitalos-product-config.mjs --write-service-workers dist-operate && node scripts/test-product-firebase-isolation.mjs dist-operate && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs stamp dist-operate --app operate
scripts.stamp:sw: node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist-firebase --app vitalos && node packages/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs splash dist-firebase --app vitalos
scripts.deploy:preview: node -e "console.error('Product preview deployment is not configured.'); process.exit(1)"
